releaseNotes: Binge Hazmat 1.16.134 - New: Fireplace in the top bar: six fireplace videos (two in 8K, two in 4K, two in 1080p) that play inside the app. New: when the player controls are on screen they also show the time on your device and the time the video will finish. Changed: trailers now play inside the app instead of opening the YouTube app, and leaving the app stops every video that is playing. Fixed: a video that loses its connection part-way (a busy Plex or file-host server, a Wi-Fi drop) or is asked to jump to a part the host will not serve now picks up again where it was, instead of stopping with a source error.
